bias.en: Uptrend, weakening · lost $182, near the $176.8 Sep 21 low
bias.zh: 上升趋势、走弱 · 失守 $182，接近 9月21日低点 $176.8

read.en: Palantir fell 3.1% on Nov 2 to $178.34 (range $178.13–187.55) on 1.5 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($190.88) and 10-day ($194.05) and the rising 30-day ($194.09), and above the rising 100-day ($162.90) and 200-day ($153.57). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16, still above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 15 ($201.78), and RSI is 38.
read.zh: Palantir 11月2日下跌 3.1%，收于 $178.34（区间 $178.13–187.55），成交量为均量的 1.5 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$190.88）和 10 日均线（$194.05）以及上行的 30 日均线（$194.09）下方，位于上行的 100 日（$162.90）和 200 日均线（$153.57）上方。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月15日起看空（$201.78），RSI 为 38。

read.en: The close broke the $182 support (Sep 22 low) and the $180.8 Oct 30 low, now resistance, closing near the day's low. Resistance is $180.8–182, then $184.5–187.6 (Oct 16 low and close, Nov 2 high) and $189.4–190.9 (October lows, 5-day). Support is $176.8 (Sep 21 low), then $162.9–164.6 (100-day, Sep 10 low). A close above $184.5 would target $187.5–190; below $176.8, $163–165.
